title: Splitting sessions with other bands and Chick Bullock recordings
summary: Sessions were split with other groups, and he accompanied Chick Bullock on Levine-label records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well I tell you, Garland Bottle was, and Glen Graves, Castle Lomas, we were splitting the sessions up. We'd go in in the morning, and then one of them would come in the evening. And then the next morning one of them would come in and we'd go in the evening. And that's how that was. But we made, then we made a recording under the Levin Longes with Chick Bullock.
Well you made those, some of those.

Yeah, I made some of those. I made the Shave and the Haircut and I made the Swingy Little Thing. And over in Europe they had somebody, they had all my band's name on the records and they had it Bob Crosby. Oh, really?
Yeah. Which label did yours come out on?
